colors: Matte dark charcoal/black housing (plastic top cover, metal bottom cover), small monochrome OLED screen near the top, four dark push-buttons + round IR receiver, micro-USB port on the side, light-grey embossed RoboMaster 'R' logo; black cable to an aviation connector with black metal ring.
notes: Official STEP from the current RoboMaster wiki (file labelled 'MC02 2019'; MC02 is still the current main controller per the 2026 Referee System User Manual V1.5). Specs: 12 V, ISM 2.4 GHz.
